sourceDescription: The official Michigan Robotics Faculty Directory renders all 37 faculty cards in a single searchable page with no pagination. Every card is retained for later person-level classification.

people.name: Ankit Goyal
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Generalist robot learning, dexterous and contact-rich manipulation, visuo-tactile manipulation policies, robot foundation models, learning from human data, 3D & spatial perception.

people.name: Bernadette Bucher
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Embodied AI, vision-language grounding, mobile manipulation, navigation and mapping, uncertainty in deep learning, and active perception.

people.name: Brent Gillespie
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Physical human-robot interaction, haptic interface, wearable robots.

people.name: Cameron Aubin
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Design and fabrication of biologically-inspired robots powered by novel, embodied energy systems; Soft robots and actuators; Microrobots; Development and characterization of autonomous materials; additive manufacturing; batteries and energy materials.

people.name: Chad Jenkins
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Mobile manipulation, computer vision, interactive robot systems, human-robot interaction.

people.name: Christoforos Mavrogiannis
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Human-robot interaction, shared autonomy, multiagent and multirobot systems, navigation in dynamic environments, decentralized control, behavior prediction, robotic manipulation

people.name: Cynthia Chestek
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Implantable brain machine interfaces, neural control of prosthetic limbs and other assistive technology.

people.name: Dawn Tilbury
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Control of manufacturing systems, teleoperation of small ground robots, shared control of robots between humans and autonomy, human-robot interaction.

people.name: Deanna Gates
people.title: Associate Professor
people.department: Robotics and Movement Science & Biomedical Engineering
people.researchInterests: Powered prostheses; human-robot interaction; outcomes assessment; 3-d movement analysis.

people.name: Dimitra Panagou
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Motion planning, coordination and control; robotic networks; autonomous multi-vehicle systems; nonlinear systems and control; navigation and guidance; distributed/decentralized control; dynamic coverage.

people.name: Dmitry Berenson
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Robot learning, motion planning, and manipulation.

people.name: Elliott Rouse
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchInterests: Precision machine design, development of robotic prostheses / exoskeletons, estimation of limb and joint mechanical impedance, neural control of locomotion, biomechanics.

people.name: Greg Formosa
people.title: Lecturer
people.researchInterests: Mechanical design engineering, especially for the design, fabrication, and control of robotic medical devices; wheeled robot dynamics, modeling, and estimation; STEM education and design engineering pedagogy.

people.name: James Weiland
people.title: Professor
people.department: Biomedical Engineering and Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences
people.researchInterests: Retinal Prosthesis for the Blind, Computer Vision for Low-Vision Assistance, Human-Computer Interaction, Visual Electrophysiology, Multi-Sensory Integration.

people.name: Jason Corso
people.title: Professor
people.department: Robotics and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
people.researchInterests: Computer vision, cognitive system learning, robot interaction, mapping, tabletop robotics.

people.name: Jessie Yang
people.title: Associate Professor
people.department: Industrial and Operations Engineering and Robotics
people.researchInterests: Human-autonomy/robot interaction, Human factors in high-risk industries, User experience design

people.name: Jessy Grizzle
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Bipedal locomotion, feedback control, nonlinear systems, CPS for robots and automotive systems.

people.name: Kira Barton
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Learning, precision coordination and motion control for multi agent systems with applications for manufacturing and autonomous robots, cooperative and vision-based control for autonomous robotic systems.

people.name: Leia Stirling
people.title: Professor
people.department: Robotics and Industrial Operations and Engineering
people.researchInterests: Biomechanics, decision support systems, human factors, human-autonomy/robot interaction, human motion, multimodal displays, work measurement, wearable technology.

people.name: Lionel Robert
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicles, human-robot interaction, teamwork with robots, collaborative autonomous robots, teleoperation, human-autonomy/robot interaction.

people.name: Maani Ghaffari
people.title: Associate Professor
people.department: Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering and Robotics
people.researchInterests: Applied mathematics, robotic perception, machine learning, and planning under uncertainty with applications in robotics and autonomous systems.

people.name: Mark Draelos
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Medical robotics, intrasurgical navigation, biomedical imaging, data visualization, medical device development, and real-time algorithms.

people.name: Necmiye Ozay
people.title: Professor
people.department: Robotics and Electrical and Computer Engineering
people.researchInterests: Control, optimization and formal methods with applications in cyber-physical system design, system identification, verification and validation, autonomy and vision.

people.name: Nima Fazeli
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchInterests: Manipulation, Robot Learning, Artificial Intelligence

people.name: Patrícia Alves-Oliveira
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Human-Robot Interaction, Embodied Social Artificial Intelligence, Human-Centered Systems, Design, Real Deployment Environments and Real Users

people.name: Peter Gaskell
people.title: Lecturer
people.researchInterests: Robotics platforms for engineering education, mapping, localization and navigation, safe autonomous systems.

people.name: Ram Vasudevan
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Optimization and control of nonlinear and hybrid dynamical systems, locomotion of legged robots, shared control active safety systems, techniques to automate diagnostic and rehabilitative tasks.

people.name: Robert Gregg
people.title: Professor
people.researchInterests: Legged robots; powered prostheses and orthoses; actuator design and control; nonlinear control theory; rehabilitation engineering; biomechanics of human locomotion.

people.name: Sean Huang
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Design, control, and modeling of autonomous multi-terrain soft robots and tensegrity robots, integration of novel soft multifunctional materials into soft machines, and development of novel soft actuators, sensors, and wearable devices.

people.name: Steven Ceron
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Swarm robotics, multi-agent systems, swarm intelligence, microrobotics; design, fabrication, and control of microrobot swarms for biomedical applications; self-reconfigurable modular robot swarms; programmable self-organization of micro-scale and macro-scale robot swarms.

people.name: Talia Moore
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Robot-animal interactions and the ecology, evolution, and control of arrhythmic motion in animals and robots.

people.name: Tribhi Kathuria
people.title: Lecturer
people.researchInterests: Socially aware robot motion planning; reasoning and task planning with vision and language models; learning from human demonstrations; human–robot interaction; imitation and inverse reinforcement learning; embodied AI and sim-to-real transfer

people.name: Xiaoxiao Du
people.title: Lecturer
people.researchInterests: Machine learning, sensor fusion, computer vision, pedestrian perception and scene understanding for autonomous vehicles.

people.name: Y Z
people.title: Professor
people.department: Nuclear Engineering & Radiological Sciences and Robotics
people.researchInterests: Robots in extreme environments; Swarm robots and collective intelligence; Wheel-legged robots; Soft robots and human-compatible machines; Far-from-equilibrium physics, long timescale phenomena, and rare events; Physics and chemistry of liquids and complex fluids, especially under interfacial/non-equilibrium/extreme conditions

people.name: Yanran Ding
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Optimization-based control for legged robots; actuator design; trajectory planning.

people.name: Yulun Tian
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.researchInterests: Robotic perception and state estimation, mapping and navigation for single and multi-agent systems, numerical and distributed optimization, robot learning.
